name: RethinkDNS-like DNS blocking and WireGuard proxy app

mentions.name: RethinkDNS-like DNS blocking and WireGuard proxy app
mentions.description: A privacy-focused DNS and proxy app similar to RethinkDNS and DNSCrypt-Proxy, built with Tauri and Svelte. It provides DNS blocklists, a custom WireGuard proxy (using Mullvad's GotaTun implementation), and potential cross-platform device support, starting with Android. It will be open-sourced if completed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on a RethinkDNS-like (Android) and DNSCrypt-Proxy-like app built with Tauri + Svelte. It will include DNS blocklists, a custom WireGuard proxy, and potentially cross-platform device support. I'm using Mullvad's GotaTun implementation.
